59:         break;

62:   }

65:     // ship control – simple acceleration
66:     if (keys.ArrowUp || keys.w) ship.vy -= ship.speed * 0.02;
67:     if (keys.ArrowDown || keys.s) ship.vy += ship.speed * 0.02;
68:     if (keys.ArrowLeft || keys.a) ship.vx -= ship.speed * 0.02;
69:     if (keys.ArrowRight || keys.d) ship.vx += ship.speed * 0.02;

72:     ship.vx *= 0.98;
73:     ship.vy *= 0.98;
74:     ship.x += ship.vx;
75:     ship.y += ship.vy;

77:     // boundary check (lose if outside)
78:     if (ship.x < 0 || ship.x > width || ship.y < 0 || ship.y > height) gameOver = true;
79:

82:       const d = debris[i];
83:       d.x += d.vx;
84:       d.y += d.vy;
